in_hebrew.name: ליזנדרוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Lysander' meaning 'man of Lyzus'. Lyzus is derived from the Greek word 'lyzein', meaning 'to free'. So Lysandros means 'God's man who sets free'.

in_greek.name: Λυσάνδρος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Lysander', meaning 'man of Lyzus'. Lyzus is derived from the Greek word 'lyzein', meaning 'to free'. So Lysandros means 'God's man who sets free'.

in_latin.name: Lysanderus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Lysander', meaning 'man of Lyzus'. Lyzus is derived from the Greek word 'lyzein', meaning 'to free'. So Lysanderus means 'liberator' or 'God's man who sets free'.
